newsitem.title: USA: Dataram sees lawsuit incurring more costs.
newsitem.headline: Dataram sees lawsuit incurring more costs.

text.p: Dataram Corp said Friday that costs from a patent lawsuit filed against it by Sun Microsystems, and its own counterclaims against Sun, will continue to have a material cost effect on results, from time to time, until the matter is concluded.
The company said increased legal expenses associated with Sun's complaint, originally filed in Oct 1996, was partly to blame for a shortfall in its fiscal first quarter earnings.

The computer memory board maker also said reduced profit margins for 64 megabit DRAM (dynamic random access memory) based products as the industry prices these products to be more competitive with 16 megabit DRAM based products, brought down earnings.
Dataram reported fiscal first quarter earnings of $0.21 a share or $669,000, compared to $0.26 a share or $964,000 during the same period a year ago.
